misconceptions.topic: Chapter 4: Photosynthesis and the Transformation of Energy
misconceptions.wrong_idea:
The Dark Reactions and Plant Respiration
Common Mistake: Plants perform photosynthesis during the day and cellular respiration only at night; furthermore, the 'dark reactions' (Calvin cycle) occur only in total darkness.
misconceptions.why_wrong: It overlooks critical qualifications or mathematical laws.
